title: Borel Conjecture
exact_target: Must any two connected closed aspherical manifolds with isomorphic fundamental groups be homeomorphic?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1481 (TOP-003). CC BY 4.0.
Wolfgang L\"uck, \emph{Survey on aspherical manifolds}, arXiv:0902.2480v3 (2009), Sections 1 and 4, Theorem 1.1 and the Borel discussion.
Guoliang Yu, \emph{The Novikov Conjecture}, arXiv:1905.12427v1 (2019), Section 1, p. 1, the all-dimensions Borel topological-rigidity formulation.
